items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And his wife Alpha? [INTERVIEWEE] Alpha. Oh boy, it was somethin' when they come in the bus...

ctx.x: Yup, one big one. Everybody was there. I think Louis had two...two Boston Bulldogs -- they was in there, too.

Alpha. Oh boy, it was somethin' when they come in the bus, with the two dogs and one thing and another. I think they had a maid, too. He had a maid and a chauffeur -- Louis had a chauffeur. Because Joe Glaser bought a big red Packard, a beautiful car, and had this chauffeur to drive for Louis, and he'd go on the road with Louis. Louis wouldn't ride in the car. He wouldn't ride in the car, I don't know why. He got in the bus; he piled up in the bus.
